info.title: HerZone member API
info.description: Small-table dinners for women in Qatar. Errors use one problem envelope (code + localised message). Times are ISO-8601 in Asia/Qatar (+03:00); money is in dirhams (minor units) with a display string. Every POST that changes data needs an Idempotency-Key; a retry with the same key replays the first answer. Access tokens last 15 minutes and stop working at once when their session ends; refresh tokens rotate on every use. The mobile app sends `X-HerZone-App: <version> <ios|android>` on every call; below the server's minimum version (MIN_APP_VERSION) any call returns 426 APP_UPDATE_REQUIRED, with min_version and store_url in details, and the app shows only an update screen.
